name: Repository Security Audit Report

goal.answer: Produce a validated markdown audit report that confirms or refutes each finding in ARCHITECTURE_DNA.md, classifies severity, and adds concrete remediation guidance for the smart-agent repository.

criteria.answer:
AUDIT_REPORT.md exists at /data/data/com.termux/files/home/smart-agent/AUDIT_REPORT.md and contains sections for Security, Architecture, Complexity, and Documentation findings (verify: `test -f AUDIT_REPORT.md && grep -c '^## ' AUDIT_REPORT.md` returns >= 4)
Every entry listed in ARCHITECTURE_DNA.md rows 9–30 appears in AUDIT_REPORT.md with a Confirmed or False-Positive verdict, a file:line citation, and a severity tag (verify: `grep -cE 'Confirmed|False-Positive' AUDIT_REPORT.md` >= 22)
Each Security finding (SEC-01, SEC-02) in the report includes an exploitability assessment and a remediation step citing the exact function/file to change
Report is written in English per AGENT.md Language & Communication Policy, contains no Arabic prose, and uses only information verifiable from existing files in the repo

constraints.answer: Audit-only: do not modify any source files in core/, engine/, tools/, ui/, scripts/, adapters/, or main.py, Do not introduce new dependencies or run destructive commands, Report must cite file:line for every finding, not just file names, English only — no Arabic prose in output per AGENT.md

assumptions.answer: The user wants an audit-only report (no source code fixes) — this is the safest default since the user cancelled the deliverable question; Security focus is highest priority because the security score is 10/100 vs 85/100 for architecture — the most dangerous gap; Medium depth: validate top 22 findings from ARCHITECTURE_DNA.md via targeted reads rather than re-running the forensic scanner; Report format: markdown at repo root, one file, four sections matching the four quality dimensions from ARCHITECTURE_DNA.md

phases.name: Audit
phases.goal: Read flagged source files, classify each finding, write AUDIT_REPORT.md

steps.description: Read the 5 security-flagged files (core/kernel/subprocess_guard.py, core/self_refinement.py, core/test_matrix_evaluator.py, core/utils.py, scripts/finalize.py) — validate each SEC-01/SEC-02 finding with file:line evidence
Read the 2 architecture-flagged files (ui/repl_termux.py, core/adapters.py) — check ACTUAL import statements to confirm or refute ARCH-01 violations
Read the 5 highest-CC complexity-flagged files (core/investigation.py, engine/_convergence.py, engine/_budget.py, engine/deep_agent.py, tools/file_system.py) — count actual cyclomatic paths
Check documentation coverage by sampling 5 engine/core modules for docstring presence
Write AUDIT_REPORT.md with findings, severity, and remediation guidance to repo root
